content: For October so far: revenue and FIFO COGS from the portal + layers. remind me what accruals I need for a mid-month view

For a mid-month view: (1) payroll — only the first pay run has posted, accrue the second half; (2) unpaid bills; (3) approved-but-unpaid member payouts (incl. ACH on hold) → 2100; (4) wallet balances → 2150; (5) consider an inventory write-down where market < FIFO cost.
